details:
Deep Space Survey Plan | ORBITAL COMMAND is an interactive web simulation game that challenges players to manage the real-world engineering constraints of space exploration.

What It Does & How It Works

  • Progressive Missions: Starting as a LV.1 Apprentice Pilot, players begin by surveying the Moon (0/3 missions, ~3 days) and level up to unlock Mars (LV.2), Europa (LV.3), Titan (LV.4), and Bennu (LV.5).
  • Resource Balancing: Players must carefully manage five critical parameters—Budget, Mass, Power, Communication, and Time—to successfully execute each planetary survey.
  • Interactive Guidance: An in-game mission control operator, "Mina (CH-01)," guides players through a futuristic Heads-Up Display (HUD).

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Hands-On STEM Education: It translates complex aerospace trade-offs (like payload weight vs. power capacity) into intuitive gameplay.
  • Inspiring Curiosity: The project aims to foster systems thinking and spark public interest in space science and exploration.

Tools & Technologies Used

  • Software & Languages: Built using the Base44 development platform alongside modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Hardware: Runs seamlessly on any standard PC or mobile web browser with no special equipment required.

Creativity & Team Considerations

  • Engaging World-Building: Combining a sleek orbital command interface with a relatable character guide turns data-heavy logistics into an immersive narrative.
  • User-Centered Design: The team selected scientifically compelling targets (icy moons and asteroids) and designed a gradual learning curve—starting strictly with the Moon—so beginners can learn complex mechanics without feeling overwhelmed.

We developed the space exploration simulation game "Deep Space Survey Plan | ORBITAL COMMAND" by combining Base44 and ChatGPT.

  • ChatGPT: Used for ideation, game balancing (progression from the Moon to Bennu), resource management logic, and writing in-game dialogue for Operator Mina.
  • Base44: Used to build and deploy the full-stack web application, creating the futuristic HUD interface and interactive parameter tracking systems (Budget, Mass, Power, Communication, and Time).
  • Workflow: By translating structured game concepts from ChatGPT into prompts for Base44, we rapidly prototyped and refined an accessible STEM educational game.
